title: Composer: Direct the shot as a staging tool
caption: The composer now reads left to right: who and where, then the shot, then the picture. Direct the shot has a stage where you drag stand-in figures into place, rows of shot size, angle and lens drawings, and each person's facing, gaze, expression and height. Keeping a face the same sits in that person's row in People. The staging goes into the prompt as words.

sections.caption: A two-person shot staged in the composer: Mio in front on the left turned toward Kenji, Kenji further back on the right, a cowboy shot, light from the left. Shot at 1366 x 768 (the left and middle columns fit without scrolling) and 2560 x 1440.
